nodes.label: ADR-003 — Postgres/TimescaleDB único, retenção de 1 mês
Decision: single Postgres+TimescaleDB — relational tables + hypertable, native 1-month retention, continuous aggregates
nodes.rationale: Two data natures (low-write registries, high-write time series) fit one engine: direct metadata<->series JOIN, one backup, one SQL paradigm, and automatic history cleanup via add_retention_policy — no manual cleanup code ever.
